headline: Names a stretch of Interstate 35 in Minnesota the "James L. Oberstar Memorial Highway" in honor of the former congressman.
what_it_does: This law gives a name to the part of Interstate 35 in Minnesota that runs from milepost 133 at Forest Lake to milepost 259 at Duluth. The road keeps its interstate number and route, and the law changes no rules about travel or construction. The name honors James L. Oberstar, a former U.S. Representative from Minnesota.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
